description: Use when the user pastes a rejection message from Apple App Review (it cites guidelines such as "Guideline 5.1.1(i)"). Free. Returns each cited guideline section it recognizes, with its title and what Apple means by it, and lists sections it does not know. The full version (likely causes, a fix list and a reply draft to App Review) is a separate paid HTTP call; the result says its price and route.

text.description: Apple's rejection message, as received (up to 20 KB)
